values.note: Booked through the Parks Canada Reservation Service (online or 1-877-737-3783), until 2 pm on the day of arrival. Check-in 2-8 pm, check-out by 11 am. One RV, two vehicles and six people per site. Generators 9-10:30 am and 5-7 pm.

note: In forest west of Lake Minnewanka Road, across the road from Two Jack Lake; cook shelters and food lockers. Loops 14, 15 and 18-21 have no firepits. --Claude
summary: Keep. 2026 dates June 18 - Sep 7, 380 unserviced reservable sites, C$29.50 plus C$12/day fire permit, dump station, no showers: all confirmed. The page gives two rig limits (24 ft and 27 ft); stored 27 left as is.
